subject: Is it possible to create a html file by using Windows ?

messages.author: 1fdbe7d9b61a7960
messages.subject: Is it possible to create a html file by using Windows ?
parts:
Hi, 

I have just started using Shiny in R. I can run the program using R on my local computer but I don't know how can I create the html file on my local server. 

Can you guys suggest how can I proceed to create a html file on my computer in Windows interface ? 

Thanks. 

Bishwamitra

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to create a html file by using Windows ?
parts:
It's not possible on justhost, which only does shared accounts. You would need a dedicated server, a VPS, or a cloud server (like Amazon EC2) because you need root access.

Here are the steps you would follow if your server is Ubuntu 12.04 or 12.10:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/wiki/Ubuntu-step-by-step-install-instructions
